AUTHOR: Villon
TITLE: A Deep learning method for accurate and fast identification of coral reef fishes in underwater images
REGION: Mayotte island, Mozambique Channel, Western Indian Ocean (50 reef sites)
SPECIES: 20 coral reef fish species from 12 families (e.g. Abudefduf sparoides, Chaetodon trifascialis, Naso elegans, Pomacentrus sulfureus, Zanclus cornutus, Zebrasoma scopas); 18 in test set, 9 in human comparison
DATA: Own stationary GoPro videos (116 videos, 25 h, 450,000 frames); 44,625 training thumbnails (T0), ~900,000 after augmentation/extra classes; 4,405 test thumbnails from 6 independent videos
V_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'at depth from 1 to 25 m ... Recording conditions varied between sites and days, especially in term of light and environment'; no turbidity metric, no stratified results
D2: 44,625 training thumbnails / 4,405 test thumbnails from 6 videos at sites or days not in training
D_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'the test dataset was built using 6 videos recorded in contexts different from those of videos used for training (i.e. sites or days not included in the training database)'
R_EV: Sec. 4: 'we considered only fixed videos recorded between 1 m and 25 m for both our training and testing datasets'; test videos from the same Mayotte campaign and cameras
C_EV: Sec. 2.4: decision rule r1 'when the first proposition of the network was environment with a confidence lower than 99% we provide ... the fish class with the highest probability'; pure classification of pre-cropped thumbnails, no detection/counting output
E_EV: Sec. 3.2: 'Mean rate of correct classification for humans was of 89.3% ... best model on the same thumbnails was of 94.9%'; only identification accuracy, no ecological variable
ARCH: GoogLeNet (22 layers, inception modules), Caffe, trained from random Gaussian initialisation for 70 epochs; 4 training-set variants (T1-T4) plus post-processing decision rules r1/r2
METR: Correct identification (success) rate per species and mean, confusion matrix, identification time (0.06 s/image vs 5 s human)
NOTE: Pure species classification on expert-cropped thumbnails (no detection/counting) -> C_ALL = NA; 99% confidence rule is a post-processing decision rule, not calibration. Split by sites/days not in training (held-out within the same Mayotte survey); coded as not external (R1=N) because it is a held-out split of the same dataset - verifier may consider site-level holdout as R1=Y. E2=Y refers to quantitative comparison with human identification accuracy on the same 1,197 thumbnails (not a census/count), hence E1 = 없음 and E_ALL = N. Only the architecture prototxt (NVIDIA DIGITS GoogLeNet) is linked, not the authors' code. Depth range (1-25 m) reported but no per-depth or visibility-stratified results. | C_ALL NA→P (classification study reporting a score threshold/reject rule; amended rule).
